name: ThemeToggle
description: The ThemeToggle component provides an intuitive button for cycling between theme modes (light, dark, and system).
usage: Cycles between light, dark, and system theme modes
Displays appropriate icon for the current theme
Compact design that works well in navigation bars
Theme cycles in the following order: Light → Dark → System
Uses the useEnhancedTheme hook to interact with the application's theme system
Forward ref enables parent components to access the button DOM node
Provides helpful title attribute for user guidance
Designed to be used in navigation bars and other UI elements where theme toggling is needed
design: Light mode displays a Sun icon
Dark mode displays a Moon icon
System mode displays a Monitor icon
Icons are rendered at 16px size with 1px stroke width
accessibility: Button has aria-label="Toggle theme" for screen readers
Title attribute shows current theme state
